title: Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.08421v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discovering continuous symmetries directly from differential-equation data can reveal geometric structure for model reduction and scientific machine learning without symbolic determining equations or a closed-form representation of the governing system. We formulate intrinsic Lie point-symmetry discovery as an operator-theoretic problem on sampled jet-space data. Admissible generators are identified from a sampled determining operator and separated from redundant, solution-dependent, and geometrically trivial directions. The framework combines prolongation, sequential subspace restrictions, and a fixed nonlinear dictionary linear in trainable coefficients. A rank-stabilization preflight test diagnoses systems whose represented intrinsic symmetry algebra does not stabilize under dictionary refinement. translated_title: 微分方程系统内蕴李点对称性的数据驱动发现
translated_abstract: 直接从微分方程数据中发现连续对称性，可以在无需符号化决定方程或控制系统闭式表示的情况下，为模型降阶和科学机器学习揭示几何结构。我们将内蕴李点对称性发现表述为采样射流空间数据上的算子理论问题。容许的生成元从采样的决定算子中识别出来，并与冗余方向、依赖于解的方向以及几何平凡的方向分离开来。该框架结合了延拓、逐次子空间约束以及一个关于可训练系数为线性的固定非线性字典。秩稳定预检测试可诊断出那些所表示的内蕴对称代数在字典细化下不稳定的系统。在一个解析已知具有11维所表示内蕴对称代数的受控微分方程基准上，该方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将内蕴李点对称性发现转化为采样射流空间数据上算子理论问题的数据驱动框架，无需符号决定方程或控制系统的闭式表示，即可从微分方程数据中直接识别出有意义的连续对称性，并过滤掉冗余与几何平凡的方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven framework that formulates intrinsic Lie point-symmetry discovery as an operator-theoretic problem on sampled jet-space data, enabling direct identification of meaningful continuous symmetries from differential-equation data without symbolic determining equations or closed-form system representations.
